name: Nassau County, NY
findings: Nassau County has 5,984 nonprofit organizations. 2,106 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 1,724 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Nassau County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
